svg.text: Azure Route Server (ASN 65515): Control Plane vs. NVA Data Plane
- Peer every NVA with BOTH ARS IPs
16 BGP peers max | 4,000 routes/peer | 10,000 total prefixes
Standard Static Public IP | No NSG, UDR, or data packets
Packets go straight to ILB VIP
AzFW does not speak BGP natively:
1. Peer 2 Linux BIRD/FRR VMs to ARS
Workload Data Plane (VM <-> ILB VIP <-> NVA / ER GW; Never Touches ARS)
BGP TCP/179 & SDN Route Control Plane (ASN 65515)
Azure Networking Field Architect Handbook | Part 2: Core Topologies (Azure Route Server Reference)
